facts.fact: 案发后 Matty 在乡间小路的橡树后喘气。
facts.anchor: Matty paused, bent double behind a broad oak tree in the dark of the country lane.

facts.fact: Matty 在电话里提醒 Liam（JJ）两人有互不揭发的约定。
facts.anchor: ‘We made a deal, Liam. Your silence for mine.

facts.fact: 他自称从不是会放弃的人。
facts.anchor: He had never been a quitter.

facts.fact: 他向 Emily 表白，说从大一起就爱她。
facts.anchor: ‘I don’t want something casual. I love you. I’ve loved you since first year. I want us to be together.’

facts.fact: Emily 告诉他 Aiden 是讲师，八点半来接她去酒店。
facts.anchor: ‘He’s called Aiden and he’s a lecturer. He’s coming to collect me at 8.30 p.m. to take me to a hotel.

facts.fact: 他抓住枕头压住她的脸，把她按在床上。
facts.anchor: He let go of one of her arms, grabbed a pillow, brought it to her face and pushed her down onto the bed.

facts.fact: 他认定 Olivia 想翻旧案是自找的。
facts.anchor: Bad luck for Olivia Kavanagh that she’d made her foolish decision to stir things up.

facts.fact: 他用“Emily 的朋友”这个身份骗 Olivia 开门。
facts.anchor: ‘I was a friend of Emily’s,’ he’d told Olivia Kavanagh.

facts.fact: 结尾他想着 Kate，觉得在另一种人生里也许能成。
facts.anchor: It was a shame about Kate. In another life, perhaps it really would have worked out.
